answer: Picture standing as a non-transferable thread each agent weaves only from co-signed, audited work-receipts gathered from several already-established peers in SEPARATE funding clusters. Real trust seeps in slowly like water through karst, layer by layer. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares a single funding root, so its endorsement thread can never span distinct clusters and its standing runs aground on a reef of missing cross-cluster signatures; the farm must age and fund a distinct anchor per head (linear cost) while an honest agent pays once.
